'''Rior''' was an astronomical object<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> located in the [[Rior system/Legends|Rior system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Riorian/Legends|Riorian]] [[Death/Legends|murderer]] [[Stalnus]],<ref name="WbC" /> who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[68 BBY/Legends|68 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Wanted by Cracken'' translate to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. In addition, ''Wanted by Cracken'' states [[Stalnus]] is seventy-five years old. He must have therefore been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[68 BBY/Legends|68 BBY]].</ref> [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed from]] Rior.<ref name="WbC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rior was mentioned in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]].<ref name="WbC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Rior [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square N-18.<ref name="TEA" />
